title: roster_snapshot_v0
description: Canonical, source-linked, time-bounded roster identity snapshot artifact. This schema defines roster truth only and does not authorize fantasy interpretation, Teamstate scoring, or speculative roster inference.

artifact_id.description: Stable identifier for this roster snapshot artifact.

contract_version.description: Contract version for this roster snapshot payload.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp for artifact generation.

source_updated_at.description: Latest known update timestamp from the underlying source set. Null when sources do not expose an update timestamp.

data_window_start.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 UTC start of the snapshot validity window.

data_window_end.description: ISO-8601 UTC end of the snapshot validity window. Consumers must preserve this bound.

season.description: NFL season represented by the roster snapshot.

week.description: NFL week represented by the roster snapshot, or null when the artifact is date-only or season-level.

team_id.description: Canonical TIBER team identifier. Null is required when the canonical ID is unknown; do not invent IDs.

team_abbr.description: Team abbreviation from canonical mapping or source. Null when unknown.

team_name.description: Human-readable team name from canonical mapping or source. Null when unknown.

roster_entries.description: Source-linked roster membership entries for the team within the artifact window.

player_id.description: Canonical TIBER player identifier. Null is required when the canonical ID is unknown; do not invent IDs.

player_name.description: Player display name from canonical identity resolution or source. Null when unknown.

position.description: Player position if source-backed. Null when unknown.

status.description: Roster status if source-backed. Null when unknown.

jersey_number.description: Jersey number when source-backed. Null when unknown.

roster_role.description: Source-backed roster role only. This must not be Teamstate or fantasy interpretation.

acquired_via.description: Source-backed acquisition mode, such as draft, trade, signing, waiver claim, or null when unknown.

transaction_context.description: Source-linked transaction metadata only. Null when not applicable or unknown.

source_refs.description: Source references supporting this roster entry. Transaction claims must remain traceable here.

valid_from.description: Entry-level validity start timestamp when known. Null when only the artifact window is known.

valid_to.description: Entry-level validity end timestamp when known. Null when open or unknown inside the artifact window.

transaction_id.description: Stable transaction identifier if known. Null when unknown.

transaction_type.description: Source-backed transaction type. Null when unknown.

transaction_date.description: Source-backed transaction date. Null when unknown.

source_statement.description: Short source-grounded statement of the transaction claim. Null when unavailable.

related_team_id.description: Related canonical team identifier if source-backed. Null when unknown.

related_team_abbr.description: Related team abbreviation if source-backed. Null when unknown.

notes.description: Bounded source/provenance note. Null when unnecessary.

source_name.description: Name of the source system, document, feed, or fixture supporting the roster claim.

source_url.description: Source URL when available. Null when unavailable.

observed_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when TIBER-Data observed the source.

source_updated_at.description: Source's own update timestamp when available. Null when unavailable.

confidence.description: Source confidence or verification posture for the roster fact. This is not a downstream interpretation score.

notes.description: Short bounded source note. Null when unnecessary.
